Theme

Tools, fasteners & household repair · Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

fix verb

fasten in place

also fasten, attach firmly, fix to the wall, put up (a picture)

classical

Hor. C. 3.5.18–19: signa … Pūnicīs adfīxa dēlūbrīs
Cic. Tusc. 5.8: Promētheus adfīxus Caucasō (Lewis & Short)

affīgō, affīgere, affīxī, affīxum

verb, third conjugation

fix, fasten (to something)

With the dative or ad: parietī affīgere, to fix to the wall. Also spelled adfīgō.

Other words

  • fīgō, fīgere, fīxī, fīxum — fix, fasten; drive in

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Ov. F. 1.158: luteum celsā sub trabe fīgit opus

Examples

  • tum blandī sōlēs, ignōtaque prōdit hirundō et luteum celsā sub trabe fīgit opus

    then the sun is mild, the swallow appears from who knows where and fixes her mud nest under a high beamOv. F. 1.157–158

  • Imāginem parietī affīgāmus.

    Let’s put the picture up on the wall.composed

See also repair, attach, nail, hang, glue, fasten with a screw.

SourcesLewis & Short: affigo · Lewis & Short: figo
